title: Beach Ready | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the serene coastal community of The Preserve at Inlet Beach, this luxurious four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach house offers the ultimate getaway experience. Designed with relaxation in mind, the open living room and well-appointed kitchen set the stage for unforgettable moments from the moment you arrive. The fully fenced backyard, complete with a covered porch, expanded patio, and fire pit, provides a private oasis where you can unwind in style. Pet-friendly and equipped with a golf cart, this home ensures that every member of the family, including the furry ones, can join in on the fun. Complimentary golf each day and a selection of bikes invite you to explore the stunning surroundings. Inside, two master en-suites, spacious living areas, and modern amenities like a 65" TV in the living room and a Keurig coffee maker in the kitchen ensure comfort and convenience for up to ten guests. Each bedroom boasts a 43" TV, with the fourth bedroom offering a bunk bed setup perfect for kids. The Preserve at Inlet Beach community enhances your stay with a pool, pavilion with an outdoor fireplace, and direct access to Lake Powell for paddleboarding and kayaking. With easy access to dining, shopping, and a short bike ride to the beach, this vacation home blends luxury, leisure, and the beauty of the Gulf Coast into a perfect coastal retreat.
